candidates.name: Goldense Building Products Inc
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists 'Toilet Partitions & Accessories' as a product line and says the company 'distributes, fabricates and installs commercial building products' and aims to 'furnish and install those products'. No partition project photos seen.
candidates.reason: Commercial furnish-and-install specialty firm about 25 miles from Providence, 'Licensed in Massachusetts & Rhode Island' with RI Contractor Registration #32367 shown on its site. Main line appears to be doors/frames/hardware; partition installation stated generally, not shown in projects.
red_flags: Sparse site (portfolio mainly doors/churches; leftover 'Sample Page')
Only email is a named individual's address

license.name: Goldense Building Products Inc
license.note: Based in Norfolk, MA. Same MA position: no state license for commercial interior work, possible CSL on permitted work (unconfirmed), and ePLACE can't be queried automatically. A separate Rhode Island CRLB check is needed for Providence-area work. Nothing verified.

candidates.partition_evidence: Projects page lists restroom partition stalls, solid phenolic and solid plastic toilet compartments installed for GCs (Lesley University, YMCA Boston, BU, Cambridge Athletic Club, Norfolk Agricultural HS); products page says 'supplying and installing toilet partitions'.

red_flags: Supplies partitions itself (buy-around risk); sister company Newton Distributing sells partitions nationally

license.name: Granite State Specialties LLC
license.registry: Rhode Island Contractors' Registration and Licensing Board (CRLB) contractor registration lookup, crb.ri.gov
license.license_type: RI CRLB contractor registration (required for commercial and residential construction work in RI, out-of-state contractors included)
license.note: Providence permits commercial work only for a contractor with a current RI CRLB registration (research/local-rules/cities.json, high confidence). Every crb.ri.gov page, including the lookup, returned HTTP 403 to automated access on 2026-11-19, so the registration could not be checked. Web search found no CRLB registration number for this company. Its own site (https://www.granitestatespecialties.com/) says it supplies and installs Division 10, 11 and 12 specialties, is based in Raymond, NH, and lists no license or registration numbers. Check by hand on the CRLB lookup or by phone.
